upstream:

        # c3

    codex: #   c5 with words

        #c7

# c8

        "stream-bootstrap-timeout": ' 5s ' #c10
    # c11
# c12
observability: # c13
    #   c14 with words

    logs: {logs-max-total-size-mb: 0}
#   c16 with words
plugins:
    enabled: true # c17
    # c18
    configs: # c19
        # c20
        alpha: &m21 # c22
            settings: &m23
                "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c24
                # c25
                retries: 0 # c26
                #c27
                #   c28 with words
                tags: &m29 #c30
                    # c31
                    - >- # c32
                      a
# c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
        # c35
        beta: &m36 # c37
# c38
            # c39
            enabled: false
            # c40
            "priority": 1 #c41
            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                "tags": *m29
                nested: {deep: {'on': true}} #c47
                # c48
        # c49
        gamma:
            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                "tags": *m29 # c53
            #   c54 with words
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #   c57 with words
    settings: {Codex: [{name: 'İstanbul', alias: ' a1 ', max-context-length: 0}, {"name": m1, alias: "", max-context-length: 200000}, {name: '', alias: pro, max-context-length: 272000}]}
    #c58
    providers: # c59
        #c60
        antigravity: &m61
            'connection-pool': {enabled: false, 'idle-conn-timeout': '90s'}
        # c62
        devin: # c63
            sensitive-words: # c64
                - "Orion" # c65
                # c66
                - acme #c67
        #   c68 with words

#   c69 with words

server: {port: 8317}

# c71
routing: # c72
    cooldown: #   c73 with words
# c74
        save-cooldown-status: false #c75

# c76
requests: {proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"} #   c77 with words

#c78
access: {api-keys: [key-1, 'sk-été', key-1, "key-3"]} # c79

#c80

    owner: >- #c82
        ops
# c83
    notes: # c84
        - first
        #c85
        - 'second note'
    limits: # c86
        # c87
#   c88 with words
        burst: 10 # c89

steps.config:
"port": 8317
"usage-statistics-enabled": false
"save-cooldown-status": false
"logs-max-total-size-mb": 0
"proxy-url": "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
"codex":
  "stream-bootstrap-buffering": false
  "orphan-delegation-compatibility": false
  "stream-bootstrap-timeout": " 5s "
"xai":
  "inject-x-search": true
"api-keys":
  - "key-1"
  - "sk-été"
  - "key-1"
  - "key-3"
"oauth-settings":
  "Codex":
    - "name": "İstanbul"
      "alias": " a1 "
      "max-context-length": 0
    - "name": "m1"
      "alias": ""
      "max-context-length": 200000
    - "name": ""
      "alias": "pro"
      "max-context-length": 272000
"xai-api-key":
  - "api-key": "key-2"
    "base-url": "http://user@"
    "disable-cooling": true
    "request-retry": 2
    "models":
      - "name": "m2"
        "alias": "sol"
        "force-mapping": false
      - "name": "m1"
        "alias": "pro"
        "thinking":
          "min": 1024
          "max": 32768
          "zero-allowed": true
          "dynamic-allowed": false
          "levels":
            - "<high>"
    "alpha-search": true
"vertex-api-key":
  - "api-key": "key-3"
    "proxy-url": ""
    "headers":
      " X-Pad ": "b"
      "X-Team": "a"
    "disable-cooling": false
    "request-retry": 0
    "models":
      - "name": ""
        "alias": "Pro"
      - "name": "gpt-6-sol"
        "alias": " a1 "
  - "api-key": "key-1"
    "prefix": "Team"
"plugins":
  "enabled": true
  "configs":
    "alpha":
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
    "beta":
      "enabled": false
      "priority": 1
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
        "nested":
          "deep":
            "on": true
    "gamma":
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "https://hook.example/run"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
"antigravity":
  "connection-pool":
    "enabled": false
    "idle-conn-timeout": "90s"
"devin":
  "sensitive-words":
    - "Orion"
    - "acme"
"x-extension":
  "owner": "ops"
  "notes":
    - "first"
    - "second note"
  "limits":
    "burst": 10
